name: FastAPI Backend API
description: A FastAPI application running on port 8000 that implements the task management REST API. Connects to PostgreSQL via DATABASE_URL env var using psycopg2.pool.ThreadedConnectionPool for connection pooling. Uses synchronous def endpoints with FastAPI's thread-pool executor. CORS middleware configured to allow frontend origin. Structured across main.py (app, CORS, lifespan/pool init), models.py (Pydantic schemas with StrEnum, validators, serializers), db.py (pool management, parameterized SQL query helpers with RealDictCursor), and routes.py (endpoint handlers with response_model/status_code decorators).

invariants: All SQL queries use parameterized placeholders (%s); no string interpolation of user input into SQL.
All public Python functions have complete type annotations (AC22).
TaskStatus enum is the single source of truth for valid status values; the set is {pending, in_progress, done}.
created_at is immutable after INSERT; only updated_at changes on UPDATE.
Empty or whitespace-only description strings are normalized to None before storage (A12).
All timestamps returned in API responses are ISO 8601 with timezone offset (AC14).
CORS middleware is configured to allow the frontend origin; configurable via environment or constant.
Connection pool lifecycle is tied to FastAPI lifespan: initialized on startup, closed on shutdown.
RealDictCursor is used for all database queries so rows are returned as dicts.
PATCH semantics on PUT /tasks/{id}: model_fields_set determines which columns appear in the UPDATE SET clause.
Title must be non-blank after whitespace stripping; blank titles are rejected with 422.
DELETE is a hard delete; no soft-delete or archival.
Test setup/teardown manages its own test data and does not depend on pre-existing database state (A10).
Contract tests are conditionally skipped when DATABASE_URL environment variable is absent.

data_access.rationale: The backend API is the sole accessor of the PostgreSQL tasks table. It reads all six columns (id, title, description, status, created_at, updated_at) to serve GET endpoints and writes title, description, status on create/update and removes rows on delete. created_at and updated_at are server-generated by PostgreSQL. DATABASE_URL is read from the environment at startup to configure the connection pool. All task data is classified INTERNAL as it contains no PII — only user-authored task titles and descriptions with no personal identifiers.

side_effects.rationale: SELECT queries on the tasks table to serve GET /tasks and GET /tasks/{id} endpoints.
INSERT and UPDATE operations on the tasks table for POST /tasks and PUT /tasks/{id} endpoints. created_at is set once by PostgreSQL DEFAULT on INSERT.
DELETE operations on the tasks table for DELETE /tasks/{id} endpoint. Hard-deletes the entire row.
Read at startup to configure the psycopg2 ThreadedConnectionPool. Contains the PostgreSQL connection URI with host, port, database name, and credentials.

authority.rationale: The backend API is the authoritative service for the tasks domain. It is the exclusive writer to the PostgreSQL tasks table, defines the canonical task schema (TaskCreateRequest, TaskUpdateRequest, TaskResponse), owns all CRUD lifecycle operations, and enforces all validation rules (status enum, title non-blank, description normalization). No other component may directly read from or write to the tasks table.
